description: This source file implements Wi-Fi configuration management functions for prplMesh, including reading and setting wireless interface parameters, retrieving BSS configurations, and handling wireless settings via UCI (Unified Configuration Interface). It defines functions for obtaining Wi-Fi interface details, credentials, operating classes, and monitored BSSs, as well as paths for control sockets.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_bss_configuration
methods.description: Retrieves SSID, authentication, and encryption settings for a given wireless section from UCI.

methods.name: cfg_get_all_prplmesh_wifi_interfaces
methods.description: Populates a list of Wi-Fi interfaces available for prplMesh.

methods.name: cfg_get_wifi_params
methods.description: Retrieves Wi-Fi parameters such as enabled state, channel, country code for a given interface.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_wireless_settings
methods.description: Collects wireless BSS configurations from UCI and fills a list with valid settings.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_wifi_credentials
methods.description: Gets Wi-Fi credentials for a specific interface.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_set_wifi_credentials
methods.description: Sets Wi-Fi credentials for a specific interface in UCI.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_mandatory_interfaces
methods.description: Retrieves the list of mandatory interfaces from prplMesh configuration.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_wpa_supplicant_ctrl_path
methods.description: Constructs the control socket path for wpa_supplicant for a given interface.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_hostapd_ctrl_path
methods.description: Constructs the control socket path for hostapd for a given interface.

methods.name: cfg_get_sta_iface
methods.description: Retrieves the station interface associated with a given AP interface.

methods.name: cfg_wifi_reset_wps_credentials
methods.description: Placeholder for resetting WPS credentials (not implemented).

methods.name: cfg_get_hostap_iface
methods.description: Gets the hostapd interface name for a given radio number.

methods.name: bpl_cfg_get_monitored_BSSs_by_radio_iface
methods.description: Retrieves monitored BSSs associated with a radio interface.
